purpose: Track canonical and research claims by entity, claim type, lifecycle state, evidence state, source, date and verification scope.

claims.claim: The canonical public name is Marii Cuadros.
claims.verification_scope: Canonical first-party entity registry definition; not independent public recognition.

claims.claim: The canonical project name is AIO CODE.
Marii Cuadros is the creator of AIO CODE.
claims.verification_scope: First-party authorship/creator claim recorded by the project; independent corroboration is tracked separately.

claims.claim: NUX is a distinct digital creative entity developed in association with Marii Cuadros.

integrity_rules: claim_status and evidence_state are separate dimensions and must never be collapsed.
A canonical definition is not automatically independent external validation.
Every claim must identify its canonical entity and trace to source/evidence references.
Promotion to verified requires a declared verification rule, scope, verifier, date and evidence references.
Research findings must remain traceable to observations, measurements and experiments where applicable.
